lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: This is the story of the lost balloon.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Tofu had a red balloon. It was the best balloon in the whole garden.

lines.speaker: pim
lines.text: Tofu! Tofu! Look what I can do!

lines.speaker: tofu
lines.text: Wow, Pim! How did you do that?

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: And just like that, the balloon was gone.

lines.speaker: tofu
lines.text: I let go of my balloon. Now it's up in the sky.

lines.speaker: bobo
lines.text: Then it can see the whole world from up there.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: And Tofu decided that was a very good place for a balloon to be.
